{{Recipe summary
| Category = Tofu recipes
| Difficulty = 2
}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Vegan cuisine|Vegan cuisine]]

==Ingredients==
* 1 block [[Cookbook:Tofu|firm or extra-firm tofu]]
* 2–3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Yogurt|yogurt]]
* {{convert|120|ml|USoz|sigfig=2}} [[Cookbook:Tomato Sauce|tomato sauce]] or [[Cookbook:Tomato Paste|tomato paste]]
* 2 tablespoons [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]] or [[Cookbook:Canola Oil|canola oil]]
* Preferred seasonings (suggested seasonings: [[Cookbook:Turmeric|turmeric]], [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]], [[Cookbook:Hot Pepper Sauce|hot sauce]], [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]])

==Procedure==
# Cut tofu into 2.5 cm (1-inch) cubes.
# Spread out the tofu on a [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|cookie sheet]] and [[Cookbook:Baking|bake]] for 20–25 minutes at {{convert|170|-|190|C|F|sigfig=2}}. This releases the extra water from the tofu and dries it out to be able to absorb the marinade.
# Mix the spices, tomato sauce, yogurt, and oil in a bowl.
# Let the tofu [[Cookbook:Marinating|marinate]] well (about 8 hours) in this mixture, preferably in the refrigerator.
# After marinating, thread the tofu onto [[Cookbook:Skewer|skewers]] and [[Cookbook:Grilling|grill]] it.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* If a grill is not available, arrange the tofu pieces on a cookie sheet and bake for 20 minutes at {{convert|170|C}}, then [[Cookbook:Broiling|broil]] for another 20 mins at {{convert|170|C}} on the middle shelf.
* If dry tofu is not preferred, then bake the tofu with the marinade in a baking dish for 30–40 minutes at {{convert|170|C}} and then broil for 20–25 mins at {{convert|170|C}}.
* To make this vegan, substitute the yogurt with [[Cookbook:Nondairy Milk|soymilk]]
* Try serving with [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]] or [[Cookbook:Naan|naan]], and [[Cookbook:Garnish|garnish]] with fresh-chopped [[Cookbook:Cilantro|cilantro]] or with fresh [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]] and [[Cookbook:Cucumber|cucumbers]].
